tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
all terms and conditions as per bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: TRADE LICENCE:-The Trade License (Catering Trade License) issued by the Commissioner of CMC or its equivalent in original should be uploaded.

FORM No.C:- The Tenderer should have valid Registration Certificate of Establishment (Form No. C) issued under Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishment act of 1961, according to Government of Karnataka, Department of Labor or its equivalent should be uploaded in original.
EPF REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE:-The Tenderer must have EPF registration Certificate Form 5A as per EPF Act and should be uploaded in original.
ESI REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE:-The Tenderer must have ESI registration Certificate as per ESI Act and should be uploaded in original.
FSSAI CERTIFICATE:-The Tenderer should have valid Registration Certificate of FSSAI(Form No. C) issued or its equivalent should be uploaded in original
GST RETURNS:- GST Returns (Form GSTR-3B) for the last six months to be uploaded in original
ITR RETURNS:-Income Tax Returns ITR for the last two years 2024-25 and 2025-26 in original should be uploaded.

ANNUAL TURN-OVER STATEMENT:-Annual Turnover statement for proceeding two financial years 2024-25 and 2025-26 of the Tenderer as per Section-XV and must having minimum Rs.267.00 Lakhs Turnover per Annum and Certified by the Charted Accountant (With UDIN Number) is to be uploaded in original.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: EPF PAYMENT CONFIRMATION RECEIPT & CHALLAN:-The Tenderer should submit the EPF Payment Confirmation Receipt & ECR Challan for last six months having remitted should be uploaded in original.
EPF PAYMENT CONFIRMATION RECEIPT & CHALLAN:-The Tenderer should submit the EPF Payment Confirmation Receipt & ECR Challan for last six months having remitted should be uploaded in original.
ESI CHALLANS:-The Tenderer should submit the ESI Challans and ECR Challans for Last 06 months having remitted should be uploaded in original.

PERFORMANCE CONTRACTS STATEMENT & EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATES:-The Tenderer must have Experience for having 1500 Bedded Hospital in similar kind of work as mentioned above in Government Hospitals/Quasi Government Hospitals/Government Autonomous Medical Institutions/Government departments for having minimum Rs.267.00 Lakhs per annum for last 02 years 2024-25 and 2025-26 the details as per the as per the Section-VIII along with Experience Certificates as per Section-IX and its related Work Orders & Work Done Certificate must should be uploaded in original.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PAN CARD:-PAN Card of the Firm/Tenderer is to be uploaded in original.
TENDER OFFER FORM:- The Tender Offer Form as per the Section VII should be uploaded in original

SELF DECLARATION:-The Agency shall give Self Declaration in Rs.200/- Stamp Paper attested by the Government Notary stating that he/she or his/her agency is/was not involved in any criminal cases /activities or his/her agency is not blacklisted by any of the authorities/Institutions as per the Section-VIII.
ADHAAR CARD:- Adhaar Card of the Tenderer should be uploaded in original

FORMAT FOR LIST OF DOCUMENTS/INFORMATION SUBMITTED UNDER THIS TENDER-SECTION-XVII-CHECK LIST. The Check list must be submitted in PDF Format & MS Word Format with recording proper information without fail.
